papers.title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?
papers.note: I co-designed the benchmark, ran model experiments and evaluated the engineering files produced at each stage.
papers.authors: Hongcheng Gao*, Hailong Qu*, Yu Lei*, et al.

papers.title: SpatialWorld: Benchmarking Interactive Spatial Reasoning of Multimodal Agents in Real-World Tasks
papers.note: I helped design the benchmark, ran experiments and evaluated how agents navigated and manipulated objects across eight simulated environments.
papers.authors: Hongcheng Gao*, Hailong Qu*, Jingyi Tang, et al.

papers.title: Predicting power and fatigue loads of yawed large offshore wind turbine based on cross-scale transfer learning
papers.note: A model pretrained on 5 MW turbine simulations was transferred to 15 MW turbines. With 40% of the target-domain data, it matched an XGBoost baseline trained on 80%.
papers.authors: Hailong Qu, Tianzhen Wei, Guoqing Huang, et al.

papers.title: Probabilistic Short-Term Forecasting of Spatially Heterogeneous Indoor CO₂ Fields with Graph-Spectral Increment Diffusion
papers.note: We model short-term changes in indoor CO₂ with graph-spectral increment diffusion to forecast concentration distributions across different locations.

papers.title: A machine learning model based on GAN-ANN data augmentation for predicting the bond strength of FRP-reinforced concrete under high-temperature conditions
papers.note: We augmented high-temperature pull-out test data using a GAN, compared six regression models and used SHAP to interpret bond-strength predictions.
papers.authors: Hailong Qu, Tianyu Hu, Jiting Qu, Woubishet Zewdu Taffese.

papers.title: Prestressed UHPC Beam Flexural Capacity Prediction Improvement with Constraint-Guided Neural Networks
papers.note: Geometric, reinforcement and material-strength constraints guide a neural network that predicts the flexural capacity of prestressed ultra-high-performance concrete beams.
papers.venue: International Journal of Bridge Engineering, Management and Research
papers.authors: Hailong Qu, Le Teng, Yanping Zhu, Zhongke Qu, Hantao Wu.
